name: Point-Bench
intro: Point-Bench 是 PointArena 的静态语言引导指向基准，包含五类共 982 组图文任务。数据通过三个匿名多模态模型与人工评审筛选高难查询，再由 SAM 辅助生成并经两轮人工标注核验目标掩码；模型以坐标点覆盖掩码并按二元 Success Rate 评分。
org: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI, Anderson Collegiate Vocational Institute
build_method: 众包查询, 模型难度过滤, SAM辅助掩码, 双阶段人工复核
task_type: 点位预测, 空间推理
eval_feature: 5类任务, 3模型高难筛选, 掩码覆盖判定, 16个MLLM, 3次独立运行
build_method_en: Crowdsourced queries, model-based hardness filtering, SAM-assisted masks, two-stage human review
eval_feature_en: Five categories, three-model hardness filter, mask-coverage criterion, 16 MLLMs, three independent runs
intro_en: Point-Bench is the static language-guided pointing benchmark in PointArena, with 982 text-image tasks across five categories. Three anonymized MLLMs and human judges filter for difficult queries, while SAM-assisted target masks receive two stages of human annotation and verification; coordinate predictions are scored with binary Success Rate by mask coverage.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.09990 Point-Bench construction and evaluation sections and the official PointArena project. Point-Bench is not a Gemini Robotics benchmark: it is the 982-pair static-image component of PointArena. Public-source images posted after April 20, 2025 are divided across spatial, affordance, counting, steerable, and reasoning categories. Crowdworkers write category-aligned queries; three anonymized MLLMs answer them; human judges retain items for which at most one model is correct. Annotators place target points, SAM proposes masks, the same annotators refine masks, and a separate annotator group verifies them. At evaluation, a model predicts K coordinates for K-star target masks. Success requires K equals K-star and every target mask contains at least one predicted point; non-counting tasks request one point and evaluate only the first if extra points are emitted. Sixteen MLLMs are run over all 982 pairs in three independent trials, reporting mean and standard deviation of Success Rate across five categories.
